info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Customer Billing Management API
info.description: The Customer Billing Management API facilitates updates to customer billing information within the financial system. It allows users to modify billing details such as payment methods, billing addresses, and invoice preferences for individual customers. This API is geared towards financial service providers and organizations looking to streamline their billing processes and enhance customer experiences. Typical consumers include internal applications, customer support teams, and financial operators who manage billing accounts.

patch.description: This endpoint allows for the modification of billing information for the customer with ID CUST-100045, enabling updates to various billing details as required.

requestBody.description: Update the billing details for a specific customer identified by CUST-100045. The request should contain the relevant fields to modify as specified in the schema.
